info.longBusinessSummary: C.C.P. Contact Probes Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in manufacturing, processing, purchasing, selling, importing, and exporting of probes and testing stations in Taiwan, the United States, and internationally. The company offers testing solutions, including IC test probes, general final test, battery probes, high-frequency, memory, fine pitch connector, ICT, wafer level, high voltage IC, Kelvin contact, burn-in, ATE connecting, and panel test solutions. It also provides waterproof, magnetic, high current and frequency, standard and non-standard, and ballpoint connectors, as well as pogo pins explained, single pogo pins, ultra-small pins, and single female pins; high current terminals; industrial and female connectors; and DAC network cables. In addition, the company is involved in investment activities; trading; manufacturing and sales of electroplating and electronic components, optical software and hardware, energy storage equipment, surface treatment of plating and plastics, and electronic measuring instruments and semiconductor integrated circuit products. The company was formerly known as CCP Contact Probes Enterprise Co., Ltd. and changed its name to C.C.P. Contact Probes Co., Ltd. in 1998. C.C.P. Contact Probes Co., Ltd. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
